derivation: Size starts at containing-or-next region, sums full sizes until start >= nonempty end. Count delegates rank subtraction including literal empty-end predecessor comparison (tail query i..infinity counts zero). Holes compare consecutive end/start and uppercase-hex endpoints; last unbounded end adds no hole. Adjacent registry results require matching endpoints; empty tree has no holes.
